title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 6.01 (versions follow prime numbers; 601 after 599): her heart answers first, before any book. Since v5.87 what her customs do not cover was looked for in her books, and an earlier rule of her author had been left out: told "I am your father" she answered with an encyclopedia sentence about a pope. Now what her customs do not cover is asked of her heart first, where who she is and who her father is are written; only what her heart does not say is looked for in her books. What she weaves is still uneven. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.57: Luma purificada. Prototipo de investigación.
